lines.text: Yeah, I put on a tough act when I’m on the clock. It's a whole thing I’m working through in therapy.
Well, you are in red so - The opulecent flounder weakly blooms bi…sexually at night?
And only once... every second week not bi-weekly meaning twice a week. Nice to meet you Agent Forty...

There’s an iPad - in the toilet - with a message. The stall. Someone got sick. They totally destroyed it. Wear gloves, and you’ll have to put the iPad in some rice - actually you know what I can just tell you the message.
LeBooBoo’s band member loves community meetups. He won’t miss a single one even for a stage performance. Get rid of the band member, and the show can’t go on.
Agent Forty. The band member is in the VIP lounge at the end of the hallway to the left of the stage.
